summary: Iteration 50 — validated the new BOOKS offering end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (/api/products?category=books returns the 3 seeded EUR books with correct type/author/amazon/ebook fields; credit-only eBook checkout (student, €645 store credit) returns {credit_only:true} and the eBook then appears in GET /api/me/downloads with title/author/images/ebook_file_url; /me/downloads is auth-gated and returns [] for a fresh user; POST /api/orders/create accepts the stock-0 eBook (stock bypass) and still rejects stock-0 print books; admin PATCH /api/admin/products/{id} persists type/author/external_amazon_link/ebook_file_url and is role-gated; POST /api/admin/uploads accepts a PDF and rejects .exe; physical-product order regression OK; no _id leakage). Frontend: homepage 'Books & reading' dark section with 3 cards (Buy on Amazon / 'Get the eBook · €14.99'), Shop 'Books' filter pill + BOOK/EBOOK badges + author lines, print-book page shows price+author+'Buy on Amazon' with NO add-to-cart/qty/stock, eBook page shows 'Instant download' badge + 'Sign in to get the eBook' when logged out and PaymentButtons (ebook-pay-stripe 'Get the eBook · €14.99' + credit toggle) when logged in, plus 'Prefer print? Buy on Amazon'. Profile 'My library' lists the purchased eBook with a working Download link to the PDF. Admin → Shop tab: book-options panel renders type/author/amazon inputs, switching type to 'ebook' reveals the file-URL input + Upload button, and Save persists across reload (values restored to originals afterwards). Cart/shipping regression works. FOUND: two hardcoded '$' currency literals (Cart line item, Passes page) breaking the EUR-everywhere requirement.

${it.price}

action_items: Cart.jsx:79 — replace the hardcoded '$' with the currency-aware symbol helper (eur → €) used elsewhere (e.g. RelatedProducts.jsx cur()).
Passes.jsx:70 (and the 'save $11' string) — same currency symbol fix so class passes render in €.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py initial products block still hardcodes currency 'usd' for the 4 fallback products (mats/apparel/journal). It only runs on an empty products collection, but a fresh deployment would seed USD items into a EUR app — switch those to 'eur'.

Currency symbol logic is duplicated in 6+ components ((c||'eur')==='usd' ? '$' : '€'); extract one shared formatMoney(price, currency) helper — the two hardcoded '$' bugs are a direct consequence of this duplication.

/api/orders/create still rejects type='book' items on stock (correct for Amazon-only books), but the error text says 'out of stock' — consider a clearer 'only available on Amazon' message if a book can ever reach the cart.

Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration50_books.py (checkout/session requires origin_url in body). Seeded book ids at time of test: print 3a9a7d40… (Core 26&40), print 2e542fa4… (Advanced 84), ebook da2f8820… (Pranayama). Only open items are the two hardcoded '$' literals in Cart.jsx and Passes.jsx — re-verify /cart and /passes render € after the fix.
rca_of_the_issue: Cart.jsx and Passes.jsx render prices with a literal '$' prefix instead of deriving the symbol from product.currency ('eur'), so the item price and the total disagree ($8 vs €8.00). All product records in the DB are currency='eur' — the defect is purely presentational and localized to those two JSX lines.
